dct_description_sm:
Individual files comprising:
1) supplemental figures for all derived region-averaged wind speed error models, including the Canadian provinces of British Columbia, Alberta, and Saskatchewan; the U.S. state of North Dakota; a combined Saskatchewan - North Dakota model; and the country of Colombia.  
2) Python code (WindSpeed.py) for interfacing with and applying these models, as well as Jupyter Notebook and a .pdf file outlining how to use the code.
3) Data file (wind-error-models.pickle) containing model coefficients that is read by the Python code
dct_title_s: Supplemental Code and Derived Models for "Accounting for spatiotemporally correlated errors in wind speed for remote surveys of methane emissions"
pcdm_memberOf_sm: The Energy & Emissions Research Lab (EERL) Dataverse
